note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable form of the task contract; tolerance and global-domain shape constraints are in task.yaml. Hidden/perf cases are {name + semantic fields} dicts: name is a metadata key that the consumer strips, then calls reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields for deterministic generation; the spatial size of dy is derived automatically by make_inputs from the forward formula, so the case does not carry out_h/out_w.

shape_family.out_layout: both directions are inherently single-tensor outputs with no concatenation packing: dgrad returns dx (N,C,H,W); wgrad returns dw (out_c,C,R,S)
